name: OneLake catalog Search API expansion to OneLake and Semantic model tables
description: The OneLake Catalog Search API (POST /v1/catalog/search) — previously limited to Fabric items — now also returns OneLake tables (e.g. Lakehouse, Mirrored) and Semantic Model tables as first-class search results. Items and tables are ranked together in a single, unified relevance-scored result set — so the most relevant result surfaces first regardless of entity type.

result.nameEs: Ampliación de la API de búsqueda de OneLake catalog a tablas de OneLake y de semantic models
result.descriptionEs: La API de búsqueda de OneLake Catalog (POST /v1/catalog/search), antes limitada a elementos de Fabric, devolverá también tablas de OneLake (por ejemplo, de Lakehouse o bases replicadas) y tablas de semantic models como resultados de primer nivel, ordenados juntos por relevancia.
